description: Verify that DUT TCP delayed-ACK fires within 0.5 sec — cumulative ACK covering two consecutive data segments arrives in time (RFC 1122 §4.2.3.2 p96)
approach:
[Objective]
The delayed-ACK optimization: after one segment, DUT may delay ACK in hope of piggyback. After two segments arrive, DUT MUST ACK (cumulative). The 0.5 s ceiling applies even when DUT chose to delay.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment #1, then segment #2.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: cumulative ACK covering both within 500 ms.

[Pass condition]
Cumulative ACK observed within 500 ms.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_cumulative_ack_within_500ms — no cumulative ACK in time

verdicts.Pass: DUT delayed-ACK fired within 500 ms — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_cumulative_ack_within_500ms: No DUT cumulative ACK for two segments within 500 ms
